three_level_model_evaluation.critique: The three-level model is highly appropriate for progressive production planning. However, Level 2 and Level 3 should NOT be separate engines. They must be progressive representations of a single unified budget model to prevent 'budget discontinuity' when moving from L2 to L3.

level_1_rapid_global.purpose: Provide instantaneous, structurally sound cost distributions for global jurisdiction comparisons before any physical production planning occurs.
level_1_rapid_global.output: Department-level totals with explicit uncertainty bands.
level_1_rapid_global.mechanism: Global standard template (e.g., US/LA benchmark) multiplied by deterministic jurisdiction cost indices.

level_2_production_informed.purpose: Generate actionable departmental budgets based on explicit script breakdowns and key producer assumptions.
level_2_production_informed.output: Sub-department or key account level budgets.

level_3_detailed_line_budget.purpose: Approximation of a line-producer budget suitable for rigorous greenlight comparisons or pre-production.
level_3_detailed_line_budget.output: Line-item budget (Quantity x Rate x Duration).
level_3_detailed_line_budget.mechanism: Bottom-up arithmetic calculation with complete user override capabilities.

mapping_examples.CAST: Speaking roles -> Cast quantity -> Shoot days duration
mapping_examples.ART_DEPT: Unique locations + Period elements -> Set build/prep duration -> Crew weeks
mapping_examples.STUNTS: Action scenes -> Stunt performer count -> Stunt days
mapping_examples.TRAVEL: Non-local locations -> Cast/Crew count -> Flights + Hotel nights + Per diem

uncertainty_confidence_model.synthetic_risk_score: PROHIBITED. Do not use opaque 0-100 risk scores.
uncertainty_confidence_model.behavior: Uncertainty is preserved at the line item and rolls up to department totals as probabilistic ranges (P10/P50/P90) rather than a single disguised point estimate.

external_cost_data: Strictly deterministic API/DB lookup. AI must NEVER invent economic rate data.

human_in_the_loop.strategy: Prompt only for the top 20% of cost drivers: Stage/Location splits, VFX intensity, main cast locations, union status. Avoid asking the producer to confirm every background extra.

budget_override_architecture.behavior: Any node (from total department cost down to individual line item) can be frozen or overridden. Provenance is strictly tracked.

failure_modes: False VFX assumptions leading to massive undercounting.
Applying local cost multipliers to global fixed costs (e.g., discounting A-list cast because shooting in a low-cost jurisdiction).
Ignoring local labor fringes and union penalties.
Fake precision: Presenting $1,234,567.89 based purely on L1 global defaults.

little_utopia_acceptance.future_fixture: Pass the LU script through the extraction pipeline. Compare L3 output to the known $4.3M LU budget. Evidence of success is matching the department ratios and recognizing the US-based post exclusion.
